question: Which of the following molecules has at least a 90º angle ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "SF4" -> "seesaw shape" -> "bond angles vary" -> "some angles greater than 90º" -> 90%
analysis: To determine which molecule has at least a 90º angle, we need to consider the molecular geometry of each option. H2O (water) has a bent shape with bond angles of approximately 104.5º. NH3 (ammonia) has a trigonal pyramidal shape with bond angles of about 107º. CH4 (methane) has a tetrahedral shape with bond angles of 109.5º. SF4 (sulfur tetrafluoride) has a seesaw shape, which includes bond angles of 90º and 120º. BF3 (boron trifluoride) has a trigonal planar shape with bond angles of 120º. Therefore, SF4 is the molecule that has at least a 90º angle.
